about.info: Hi, I’m Tobias, a passionate fullstack developer. I enjoy turning ideas into functional and user-friendly applications. My goal is not only to write working code, but to create solutions that stand out through clear structure, thoughtful design, and an enjoyable user experience.
about.from: I’m based in Brunswick, Germany, and open to remote work as well as exciting professional opportunities beyond my region.
about.open: I’m open to new ideas and technologies and continuously work on expanding my skills. I see new challenges as opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.
about.problem: I break complex problems down into manageable steps and solve them through analytical thinking, creativity, and persistence. I value collaboration and use every challenge as an opportunity to learn.

skills.title: Skill Set
skills.description: My skill set includes modern frontend technologies as well as experience with backend development and databases. I enjoy learning new tools, adapting to technical challenges, and continuously improving my knowledge to keep pace with the evolving world of web development.
skills.contactText: Feel free to contact me. I am always interested in expanding my knowledge and learning new technologies.
